sets.subject: English
sets.passage_en: Sleep is essential for good health. During sleep, the body (1) ______ itself and the brain sorts out the day's experiences. People who regularly (2) ______ less than six hours may find it hard to concentrate. Caffeine late in the day can (3) ______ sleep, so experts advise avoiding it in the evening. A regular bedtime routine also (4) ______ the body prepare for rest. Good sleep is not a luxury; it is a (5) ______ part of a healthy life.
sets.passage_hi: अच्छे स्वास्थ्य के लिए नींद आवश्यक है। नींद के दौरान शरीर स्वयं की (1) ______ करता है और मस्तिष्क दिन के अनुभवों को व्यवस्थित करता है। जो लोग नियमित रूप से छह घंटे से कम (2) ______ करते हैं, उन्हें ध्यान केंद्रित करने में कठिनाई हो सकती है। दिन में देर से ली गई कैफीन नींद को (3) ______ कर सकती है, इसलिए विशेषज्ञ शाम में इसे न लेने की सलाह देते हैं। नियमित सोने का समय शरीर को आराम के लिए तैयार होने में भी (4) ______ करता है। अच्छी नींद विलासिता नहीं; यह स्वस्थ जीवन का (5) ______ हिस्सा है।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the word most similar in meaning to METICULOUS.
questions.text_hi: METICULOUS के अर्थ के सबसे निकट शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail; 'careful' is the closest synonym.
questions.solution_hi: Meticulous का अर्थ है विस्तार पर बहुत ध्यान देना; 'careful' सबसे निकट समानार्थी है।
questions.trick_en: Link meticulous with 'meticulous detail' — very careful.
questions.trick_hi: Meticulous को 'बारीकी से सावधान' से जोड़ें।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to 'scarce'.
questions.text_hi: 'scarce' के अर्थ के सबसे निकट विपरीत शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: Scarce means in short supply; its opposite is abundant. The other options are near-synonyms.
questions.solution_hi: Scarce का अर्थ है कम उपलब्ध; इसका विपरीत abundant है। अन्य विकल्प निकट समानार्थी हैं।
questions.trick_en: Eliminate options that also mean 'not enough'.
questions.trick_hi: जो विकल्प भी 'कम' का अर्थ दें उन्हें हटाएँ।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.text_hi: सही वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: The correct spelling is 'government': govern + ment, with an 'n' before 'ment'.
questions.solution_hi: सही वर्तनी 'government' है: govern + ment, 'ment' से पहले 'n'।
questions.trick_en: Say the word slowly: gov-ern-ment; do not drop the first 'n'.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: What does the idiom 'break the ice' mean?
questions.text_hi: मुहावरे 'break the ice' का अर्थ क्या है?

options.en: Start a conversation in an awkward situation
options.hi: असहज स्थिति में बातचीत शुरू करना

questions.solution_en: 'Break the ice' means to ease initial awkwardness and start a conversation. It is figurative, not literal.
questions.solution_hi: 'Break the ice' का अर्थ है शुरुआती असहजता दूर करके बातचीत शुरू करना। यह लाक्षणिक है, शाब्दिक नहीं।
questions.trick_en: Idioms are figurative; choose the social meaning.
questions.trick_hi: मुहावने लाक्षणिक होते हैं; सामाजिक अर्थ चुनें।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: One word for 'a person who writes books' is:
questions.text_hi: 'पुस्तकें लिखने वाला व्यक्ति' के लिए एक शब्द है:
questions.solution_en: An author writes books. A publisher produces and distributes them, an editor prepares the text and a reader reads it.
questions.solution_hi: Author पुस्तकें लिखता है। Publisher उन्हें प्रकाशित करता है, editor पाठ तैयार करता है और reader पढ़ता है।
questions.trick_en: Focus on the act of writing, not printing or selling.
questions.trick_hi: लिखने की क्रिया पर ध्यान दें, छापने या बेचने पर नहीं।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct word: The ______ of the new policy was felt across the country.
questions.text_hi: सही शब्द चुनें: The ______ of the new policy was felt across the country.
questions.solution_en: 'Effect' is a noun meaning a result. 'Affect' is usually a verb meaning to influence. The blank needs the noun.
questions.solution_hi: 'Effect' संज्ञा है जिसका अर्थ परिणाम है। 'Affect' सामान्यतः क्रिया है जिसका अर्थ प्रभावित करना है। रिक्त स्थान में संज्ञा चाहिए।
questions.trick_en: If you can put 'the' before it, use the noun 'effect'.
questions.trick_hi: यदि पहले 'the' लग सके, तो संज्ञा 'effect' चुनें।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: What does the phrasal verb 'give up' mean?
questions.text_hi: फ्रेज़ल वर्ब 'give up' का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.solution_en: 'Give up' means to stop doing something or quit.
questions.solution_hi: 'Give up' का अर्थ है किसी काम को छोड़ देना या बंद कर देना।
questions.trick_en: Contrast give up with give in (surrender) and give away (donate).
questions.trick_hi: give up की तुलना give in (हार मानना) और give away (दान करना) से करें।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct article: He is ______ university student.
questions.text_hi: सही आर्टिकल चुनें: He is ______ university student.
questions.solution_en: 'University' begins with the consonant sound /juː/, so the article 'a' is used, not 'an'.
questions.solution_hi: 'University' का उच्चारण व्यंजन ध्वनि /juː/ से शुरू होता है, इसलिए 'a' आता है, 'an' नहीं।
questions.trick_en: Articles depend on sound: a university, an umbrella.
questions.trick_hi: आर्टिकल ध्वनि पर निर्भर है: a university, an umbrella.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct preposition: She is afraid ______ spiders.
questions.text_hi: सही पूर्वसर्ग चुनें: She is afraid ______ spiders.
questions.solution_en: The standard collocation is 'afraid of'.
questions.solution_hi: मानक संयोजन 'afraid of' है।
questions.trick_en: Learn fixed pairs: afraid of, fond of, proud of.
questions.trick_hi: स्थिर जोड़ियाँ याद रखें: afraid of, fond of, proud of.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct option: The list of items ______ on the table.
questions.text_hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: The list of items ______ on the table.
questions.solution_en: The subject is 'the list' (singular), not 'items'. A singular subject takes 'is'.
questions.solution_hi: कर्ता 'the list' (एकवचन) है, 'items' नहीं। एकवचन कर्ता के साथ 'is' आता है।
questions.trick_en: Ignore the prepositional phrase 'of items' when finding the subject.
questions.trick_hi: कर्ता खोजते समय 'of items' वाक्यांश को छोड़ दें।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Identify the part containing the error: He / do not / like coffee. / No error
questions.text_hi: त्रुटि वाला भाग पहचानें: He / do not / like coffee. / No error
questions.solution_en: 'He' is third-person singular, so the correct auxiliary is 'does not': He does not like coffee.
questions.solution_hi: 'He' तृतीय पुरुष एकवचन है, इसलिए सही सहायक क्रिया 'does not' है: He does not like coffee.
questions.trick_en: Match the auxiliary to the subject: he/she/it → does.
questions.trick_hi: सहायक क्रिया कर्ता से मिलाएँ: he/she/it → does.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct option: She ______ here since 2020.
questions.text_hi: सही विकल्प चुनें: She ______ here since 2020.
questions.solution_en: 'Since 2020' shows an action continuing from the past to now, so the present perfect 'has worked' is correct.
questions.solution_hi: 'Since 2020' भूतकाल से अब तक जारी क्रिया दर्शाता है, इसलिए present perfect 'has worked' सही है।
questions.trick_en: Since/for with a continuing action → has/have + past participle.
questions.trick_hi: जारी क्रिया के साथ since/for → has/have + past participle.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct pronoun: The book is ______.
questions.text_hi: सही सर्वनाम चुनें: The book is ______.
questions.solution_en: 'Mine' is the possessive pronoun that stands alone after 'is'. 'My' needs a noun after it.
questions.solution_hi: 'Mine' स्वतंत्र अधिकारवाचक सर्वनाम है जो 'is' के बाद अकेला आता है। 'My' के बाद संज्ञा चाहिए।
questions.trick_en: Use mine/yours/hers when no noun follows.
questions.trick_hi: जब बाद में संज्ञा न हो तो mine/yours/hers लगाएँ।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I English syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct modal: You ______ finish the work by tomorrow, or you will fail.
questions.text_hi: सही मॉडल चुनें: You ______ finish the work by tomorrow, or you will fail.
questions.solution_en: 'Must' expresses strong obligation or necessity, which fits the warning about failing.
questions.solution_hi: 'Must' तीव्र बाध्यता या आवश्यकता दर्शाता है, जो असफल होने की चेतावनी से मेल खाता है।
questions.trick_en: For strong obligation, choose must; might/could show possibility.
questions.trick_hi: तीव्र बाध्यता के लिए must चुनें; might/could संभावना दर्शाते हैं।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I English syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct conjunction: ______ it rained, the match continued.
questions.text_hi: सही संयोजक चुनें: ______ it rained, the match continued.
questions.solution_en: The two clauses contrast, so 'Although' is correct: Although it rained, the match continued.
questions.solution_hi: दोनों उपवाक्य विरोध दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए 'Although' सही है: Although it rained, the match continued.
questions.trick_en: Ask whether the second clause is a contrast, cause, result or condition.
questions.trick_hi: देखें कि दूसरा उपवाक्य विरोध, कारण, परिणाम या शर्त है या नहीं।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct passive form: The chef cooked the meal.
questions.text_hi: सही कर्मवाच्य रूप चुनें: The chef cooked the meal.

options.en: The meal was cooked by the chef.
options.hi: The meal was cooked by the chef.

options.en: The meal is cooked by the chef.
options.hi: The meal is cooked by the chef.

options.en: The meal has cooked by the chef.
options.hi: The meal has cooked by the chef.

options.en: The meal was cooking by the chef.
options.hi: The meal was cooking by the chef.

questions.solution_en: Simple past active 'cooked' becomes 'was/were + cooked' in the passive. The object 'the meal' becomes the subject.
questions.solution_hi: सामान्य भूतकाल का 'cooked' कर्मवाच्य में 'was/were + cooked' होता है। कर्म 'the meal' कर्ता बन जाता है।
questions.trick_en: Keep the tense: simple past → was/were + past participle.
questions.trick_hi: काल न बदलें: simple past → was/were + past participle.

questions.subject: English
questions.sub_topic: Shuffling of sentences in a passage
questions.text_en: Arrange the sentences in the correct order: Q. The library was silent. S. A student dropped a book. P. Everyone looked up. R. She apologised softly.
questions.text_hi: वाक्यों को सही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें: Q. The library was silent. S. A student dropped a book. P. Everyone looked up. R. She apologised softly.
questions.solution_en: Q sets the scene, S introduces the sudden event, P gives the reaction and R gives the resolution. The order is Q S P R.
questions.solution_hi: Q दृश्य प्रस्तुत करता है, S अचानक घटना बताता है, P प्रतिक्रिया और R समाधान देता है। क्रम Q S P R है।
questions.trick_en: Follow cause and effect: silence → noise → reaction → apology.
questions.trick_hi: कारण-प्रभाव क्रम देखें: शांति → आवाज → प्रतिक्रिया → माफी।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I English syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.sub_topic: Shuffling of sentences in a passage
questions.text_en: Arrange the sentences in the correct order: Q. The team practised daily. R. They won the final match. S. The crowd cheered loudly. P. Their coach was proud.
questions.text_hi: वाक्यों को सही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें: Q. The team practised daily. R. They won the final match. S. The crowd cheered loudly. P. Their coach was proud.
questions.solution_en: Q describes preparation, R the result, S the crowd's immediate reaction and P the coach's concluding feeling. The order is Q R S P.
questions.solution_hi: Q तैयारी, R परिणाम, S भीड़ की तत्काल प्रतिक्रिया और P कोच की भावना बताता है। क्रम Q R S P है।
questions.trick_en: Follow the timeline: practice → win → celebration → reflection.
questions.trick_hi: समय-क्रम देखें: अभ्यास → जीत → उत्सव → भावना।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I English syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Rearrange the parts to form a meaningful sentence: P. the librarian Q. carefully R. arranged S. the new books
questions.text_hi: अर्थपूर्ण वाक्य बनाने के लिए भागों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: P. the librarian Q. carefully R. arranged S. the new books
questions.solution_en: The subject 'the librarian' comes first, the adverb 'carefully' modifies the verb 'arranged', and the object 'the new books' follows it: P Q R S.
questions.solution_hi: कर्ता 'the librarian' पहले आता है, क्रिया विशेषण 'carefully' क्रिया 'arranged' को बताता है और कर्म 'the new books' उसके बाद आता है: P Q R S।
questions.trick_en: Place subject → adverb → verb → object; an adverb never splits the verb from its object here.
questions.trick_hi: कर्ता → क्रिया विशेषण → क्रिया → कर्म रखें; यहाँ क्रिया विशेषण क्रिया और कर्म को नहीं तोड़ता।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I English syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Rearrange the parts to form a meaningful sentence: P. after the long journey Q. the travellers R. rested S. under a shady tree
questions.text_hi: अर्थपूर्ण वाक्य बनाने के लिए भागों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: P. after the long journey Q. the travellers R. rested S. under a shady tree
questions.solution_en: The introductory phrase 'after the long journey' comes first, then the subject 'the travellers', the verb 'rested' and the place phrase 'under a shady tree': P Q R S.
questions.solution_hi: प्रारंभिक वाक्यांश 'after the long journey' पहले, फिर कर्ता 'the travellers', क्रिया 'rested' और स्थान वाक्यांश 'under a shady tree' आता है: P Q R S।
questions.trick_en: Front the time phrase, then keep subject–verb–place together.
questions.trick_hi: समय वाक्यांश आगे रखें, फिर कर्ता–क्रिया–स्थान को साथ रखें।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Sleep and health passage: choose the most appropriate word for blank (1).
questions.text_hi: नींद और स्वास्थ्य पर आधारित गद्यांश: रिक्त स्थान (1) के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: The subject 'the body' is singular, so the present simple verb takes -s: the body repairs itself.
questions.solution_hi: कर्ता 'the body' एकवचन है, इसलिए present simple क्रिया में -s लगता है: the body repairs itself।
questions.trick_en: Find the subject: 'the body' is singular.
questions.trick_hi: कर्ता खोजें: 'the body' एकवचन है।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Sleep and health passage: choose the most appropriate word for blank (2).
questions.text_hi: नींद और स्वास्थ्य पर आधारित गद्यांश: रिक्त स्थान (2) के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: The subject 'people' is plural, so the base form 'sleep' is correct: people sleep less than six hours.
questions.solution_hi: कर्ता 'people' बहुवचन है, इसलिए मूल रूप 'sleep' सही है: people sleep less than six hours।
questions.trick_en: After the plural subject 'people', use the base verb.
questions.trick_hi: बहुवचन कर्ता 'people' के बाद मूल क्रिया लगाएँ।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Sleep and health passage: choose the most appropriate word for blank (3).
questions.text_hi: नींद और स्वास्थ्य पर आधारित गद्यांश: रिक्त स्थान (3) के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: After the modal 'can', the base form of the verb is used: can disrupt sleep.
questions.solution_hi: मॉडल 'can' के बाद क्रिया का मूल रूप आता है: can disrupt sleep।
questions.trick_en: Modals can/could/may/must take the base verb.
questions.trick_hi: मॉडल can/could/may/must के बाद मूल क्रिया आती है।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Sleep and health passage: choose the most appropriate word for blank (4).
questions.text_hi: नींद और स्वास्थ्य पर आधारित गद्यांश: रिक्त स्थान (4) के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: The subject 'a regular bedtime routine' is singular, so the verb is 'helps'.
questions.solution_hi: कर्ता 'a regular bedtime routine' एकवचन है, इसलिए क्रिया 'helps' है।
questions.trick_en: Singular subject in the present simple → verb + s.
questions.trick_hi: present simple में एकवचन कर्ता → क्रिया + s।

questions.text_en: Sleep and health passage: choose the most appropriate word for blank (5).
questions.text_hi: नींद और स्वास्थ्य पर आधारित गद्यांश: रिक्त स्थान (5) के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: The blank needs an adjective before 'part': an essential part. 'Essentially' is an adverb, 'essence' and 'essentiality' are nouns.
questions.solution_hi: रिक्त स्थान में 'part' से पहले विशेषण चाहिए: an essential part। 'Essentially' क्रिया-विशेषण है, 'essence' और 'essentiality' संज्ञा हैं।
questions.trick_en: Check the word class needed before the noun 'part'.
questions.trick_hi: संज्ञा 'part' से पहले कौन-सा शब्द वर्ग चाहिए, देखें।
